newsitem.title: ITALY: Generali free cap increase starts Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: Generali free cap increase starts Sept 23.

text.p: Italian insurer Assicurazioni Generali SpA said on Wednesday its free one-per-10 capital increase would start on September 23 and run until October 22.
The Trieste-based company said in a statement it would issue 80.16 million free ordinary shares on the basis of one new share for every 10 held.
Generali said it the operation will increase its share capital to 1.763 trillion lire from 1.603 trillion, made up of 881.79 million shares of a nominal 2,000 lire value.
The follows a decision taken by the board at the company's annual general meeting on June 29.
